packageRules.description: Zitadel ships zitadel-api and zitadel-login as one product on one version scheme — keep them in lockstep instead of letting one drift ahead of the other.
ClickHouse server and keeper need matching versions to avoid protocol/version skew between them.

install.sh pins sops and yq by exact version PLUS a hand-verified SHA-256 checksum per architecture. This custom manager only bumps the version string in install.sh — it cannot know the new release's checksums.
prBodyNotes: **Manual follow-up required before merging:** install.sh hardcodes a SHA-256 checksum for this binary alongside the version pin (`SOPS_SHA256_AMD64`/`SOPS_SHA256_ARM64` or `YQ_SHA256_AMD64`/`YQ_SHA256_ARM64`). This PR only updates the version string — fetch the matching checksum(s) for the new release from the upstream project and update install.sh by hand, or the installer will fail at install time with a checksum-mismatch error.

customManagers.description: Track the SOPS_VERSION pinned in install.sh against github.com/getsops/sops releases.
Track the YQ_VERSION pinned in install.sh against github.com/mikefarah/yq releases (the Go mikefarah/yq this codebase requires, not the unrelated Python kislyuk/yq).
